verdict.rationale: Capacities documents itself as offline-first: you can work offline, changes sync when you reconnect, and search works offline on all devices. Notes can be read without the app only through Markdown + CSV exports, which can run on an automated schedule and are described as human- and machine-readable. The working store is not plain local files the user owns. Missing for 10: notes stored natively as local files or a user-owned local store (ownership relies on periodic export snapshots), evidence that every feature works fully offline, and independent or hands-on corroboration of offline behavior.
